faqs.question: How do I know if I have bats in my Springfield Gardens home?
faqs.answer: Common signs include scratching or squeaking sounds in your attic at dusk or dawn, dark stains near roof edges or vents, small droppings (guano) that crumble easily, and seeing bats emerge from your home at sunset. Many Springfield Gardens homeowners first notice bats flying around their property during warm evenings.

faqs.question: Is bat removal legal in NYC and Queens?
faqs.answer: Yes, but it must be done humanely and in compliance with NYC wildlife regulations. Bats are protected species, so removal must occur outside maternity season (typically June through August) when flightless young may be present. A Best Pest Control NYC technician — licensed by the NYS DEC or working under the direct supervision of a licensed applicator — follows all legal requirements for safe, humane bat exclusion in Springfield Gardens.

faqs.question: What does the bat exclusion process involve?
faqs.answer: We conduct a thorough inspection to locate all entry points, install one-way exclusion devices that allow bats to leave but not return, seal all other potential openings, and perform cleanup of contaminated insulation and guano.
